list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (via Planet GTA 6), checked 19 November 2026
notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones. Guides are written for this entry in our own words from the sources cited beside each trophy; where no source has confirmed a method yet, the guide says so honestly. PowerPyx is the main method source; the official list comes from Exophase / PSNProfiles as reported by Planet GTA 6.

roadmap.text: Finish Chapters 1–5 and take every optional mission as it appears. Start the meditation habit in Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude — the one trophy that may be missable), scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you go, and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game+.
roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story

roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The checklist is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts. Most of this stage's trophies pop while you work the list.
roadmap.title: Stage 2 — 100% Completion and challenges

roadmap.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, the partner robberies, the one-off secret trophies and the money goals. Everything here is still available in free-roam after the story.
roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Strangers, robberies and cleanup

roadmap.text: Vice Got a Price! unlocks the moment the last of the other 54 pops. Total: around 200 hours, difficulty about 4/10.
roadmap.title: Stage 4 — The Platinum

trophies.guide: The Platinum is the reward for the other 54 trophies — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers strands and the one-off trophies. At roughly 200 hours and difficulty 4/10 it is long, not hard, and every trophy is single-player.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the one that decides the Platinum's length. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 optional missions, 15 of 18 meditations. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: Finish the story, scanning vehicles and studying animals as you go.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the list: 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 70 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 optional missions.
Clear the full-requirement items: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's quests.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like, and under-the-bridges runs are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: Fly or drive under bridges — the fastest stunt type.
Mix in stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps as you find them.
Track by region: Progress > Activities > Stunts.
Reach 250 completed stunts (300 for the 100% checklist).

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your coverage under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most of them happen on their own while you work on the other trophies, and the story introduces you to several — do not grind this one early.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see what is left.
Fish, hunt, play golf, pool and basketball once each.
Clear one shooting range and finish one arcade game.
Win one race and perform one stunt.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx links a full location guide and rates the golds as not too difficult. Ranges also feed your Focus stat, which helps Gunslinger, and every range is required for the 100% checklist — so this silver is really part of Stage 2, not a separate grind.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Find the 12 shooting ranges (filter Activities on the map).
Play each range's challenges until you hold gold in all 42.
Use range practice to raise Focus for the Gunslinger trophy too.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races in total). PowerPyx links a full location guide. Drone races are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so treat this as part of Stage 2 — and a drone-race win also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win at least one race at every location.
Finish all 42 races for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to pick from as you need — choose the car races you are comfortable with and skip the rest. A race win also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

Win 20 different ones — any vehicle class you like.
Replays of the same race do not count; each win must be a new location.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. The questline starts early, so answer the text when it arrives rather than leaving it for the endgame.

Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game — no need to beat every challenge inside it. The home TV is available from Chapter 1, though it is temporarily off-limits during some story sections.

Play through all of its levels to the end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline — 5 quests, Lucia only. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, answer Andy's call and text.
Follow the marker to Andy's home in Belville.
Complete all 5 Andy quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline — 7 shipwrecks in total. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1: after the Island Dreams mission he calls you, then the green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure chests on the map; dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2–3 (as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), and everything stays available after the story. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

Answer his call; follow the KR marker in Key Lento.
Clear all 7 shipwreck treasure sets and return them to Kenton.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline — 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not, even though they look like strangers. Confirmed counting strands so far: Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove, 3 quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, 3 quests), Yago (street racing mentor, 4 quests) and Pilot Pete (5 delivery quests). More strands are still being confirmed, and all of them remain available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Find strangers with ? markers in the open world after the story.
Complete the Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete strands.
Keep going until 8 counting strands are done — check the trophy tracker.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he asks for. It opens automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for him with the Key Cloner. He marks cars in fixed spots, but you can steal any matching car off the street — scan it with WAiNK first to check it is on the list, then drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Deliveries in good condition pay more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs and deliver the Zorrusso.
Check Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List for the 16 cars.
Scan, steal and deliver each car to Randy's garage.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — Jason only. It opens automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City, and the quest Take Out Kitty Litter has you destroy them. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which pops the trophy. It all stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty as Jason.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City.
Take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, and finish it.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Both Jason and Lucia can meditate at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the Down to Earth mission, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony at Jason's house — follow her, choose Accept, and do the meditation. It adds +1 to the counter but is not listed as a spot, and it is gone after Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is actually required for the trophy, but do it anyway — it costs a minute. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1. It is unconfirmed whether it is required for this trophy, but it is the only missable interaction reported so far — do it in Chapter 1 and keep a chapter-start save.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations for the count.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline — Jason only. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. His quests are about hunting the animals he requests and bringing them back; on the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all required for the 100% checklist. It stays available after the story; which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up on the D-pad, then hold R1 to scan what you are looking at. There are far more than 100 scannable spots — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — so any 100 will do. Scanning also feeds the vehicle-discovery count, so do it constantly while travelling.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then hold R1 to scan).
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags as you travel.
Reach 100 scanned locations.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. They sit under Progress > Challenges, in 8 categories of 10, and many complete naturally while you work on the other trophies. Leave this one late, then pick the easiest remaining challenges — the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: Play normally; challenges complete as you go.
Check Progress > Challenges for what is left.
Pick the easiest remaining challenges until you hit 50 (70 for 100%).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. The easiest escape PowerPyx suggests is driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4-star heat.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Cause chaos until you reach 4 stars.
Escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time. It opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level (not the red heat level), wear an armored vest, and carry sticky bombs plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a couple of items and the back-room safe in each. If it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth; the unlock is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the last shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner.
Gear up: armored vest, sticky bombs, healing items.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level (a 4th if it does not pop).

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: stand on a busy road and scan passing vehicles (hold Up, then hold R1). You only need to scan them, not drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops early on the way there. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: Open WAiNK (hold Up, then hold R1) on a busy road.
Scan every new vehicle that passes.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles (200 for the 100% checklist).

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but the purple focus bar drains in seconds. Prepare first: eat or drink to buff focus, carry Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — raise it at shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and by the endgame you will likely pop this naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: Raise Focus toward level 4 (ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots).
Buff focus with food/drink and Adrenaline; wear body armor.
Find 5 enemies together at a gang operation.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take all 5 down.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — the ones parked on the open airfield do not work. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence onto the airfield, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, go in, head upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the strip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it lands.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: Go to VCIA and drive onto the airfield through a fence.
Board the plane docked at terminal E3/E4 via the stairs by the bridge.
Enter the cockpit, reverse to the strip, take off and fly 1 km clear.

trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive in through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Enter the base and find the tanks in the south.
Climb into a Rhino and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry stores with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it — that trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. A good target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It opens with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open after the guard carries the briefcase in, and grab the cash — bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip (after his earlier Payday Loans jobs). Each vault robbery instantly triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs; you need 5 here but all 8 for the 100% checklist, and one vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The easy route is automatic: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is has you tail an armored truck to a bank, and robbing that vault counts as robbing the truck. You can also do it earlier — block a truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them (many are also marked automatically from story progress). You only need 1 per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it pops on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving down the street — the pop is slightly delayed. It only works with this specific blue Banshee, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside you need: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for what is left.

trophies.guide: Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to maximum at the same time. It opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon). Work out at fitness clubs — buy a membership, filter for clubs on Map > Activities — and always bring your partner (hold Right and press Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other completes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. The profile runs from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable if you keep using excessive violence — Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going that far. You will rack up most of the 500 passively through robberies and fights on the way to 100%; if you are short at the end, the fastest farm is running over civilians and cops with a car, though cops will shoot on sight more often at Psycho or worse.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not one delivery, and the bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery. It comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — buy what you actually want and the total climbs on its own. This is cumulative spending, not one purchase.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies are the fastest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each one adds parking spots for registered vehicles.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, and it lets you call registered stolen vehicles to your location. Drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. You need enough garage space first (see Little Boxes), and registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.

warnings: Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude — do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before Chapter 1 ends.
There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots plus 1 autosave).
Cheats disable trophies and saving, and only unlock after the story anyway — keep them off a trophy run.
No trophy needs online play: all 55 unlock in single-player.
